prediction.likelyOutcome: Liability is already fixed in Allied Development's favor by partial summary judgment, so the only real question at the ore tenus hearing is the size of the damages award, which will turn on how the court treats the reletting to an existing mall tenant as mitigation. Expect an award materially below the full $146,910 currently claimed but well above IGO's proposed $18,900 floor, likely in the $80,000-$120,000 range once mitigation credit is properly calculated, plus enforcement of the guaranty against Carver personally for whatever amount is awarded.

issues.label: Future Rent/Acceleration Damages Amount (Mitigation Credit Dispute)
Breach of Quiet Enjoyment / Failure to Market and Maintain (Liability Defense)

outcome.description: After a damages hearing, the Baldwin Circuit Court rendered judgment for the landlord in the amount of $94,350 plus costs of court against the tenant and guarantor (the landlord had claimed $89,010 in its summary-judgment motion and later $146,910; the tenant argued for no more than $18,900). Attorney's fees were not separately stated. The Supreme Court of Alabama affirmed both the liability determination and the damages judgment.
